lines.beaver_en: Hello. Which cultural assets did you see today?
lines.en: I saw this pottery. It's really beautiful.

lines.beaver: 그 도자기에는 용이 그려져 있어요. 전설도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: There's a dragon painted on it. There's a legend, too.
lines.beaver_roman: geu dojagieneun yongi geuryeojyeo isseoyo. jeonseoldo isseoyo.
lines.en: A dragon legend? I love old folk tales.

lines.beaver_en: People long ago prayed to dragons for rain.
lines.en: Oh, so they prayed, wishing for rain.

lines.beaver: 네, 그게 옛날 풍습이었어요. 종교와도 관계있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, that was an old custom. It's related to religion, too.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, geuge yennal pungseubieosseoyo. jonggyowado gwangyeisseoyo.
lines.learner: 도자기에 기도를 담았다니 생각도 못 했어요.
lines.en: I never imagined they put prayers into pottery.
lines.roman: dojagie gidoreul damatdani saenggakdo mot haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: This pottery is really big, isn't it?
lines.learner: 네, 제 동생만 해요. 정말 놀라워요.
lines.en: Yes, it's as big as my little brother. Amazing.
lines.roman: ne, je dongsaengman haeyo. jeongmal nollawoyo.

lines.beaver: 부채도 보셨어요? 저쪽에 전통 부채가 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Did you see the fans too? There are traditional fans over there.
lines.beaver_roman: buchaedo bosyeosseoyo? jeojjoge jeontong buchaega isseoyo.
lines.en: Yes, I did. The traditional pictures were pretty.

lines.beaver_en: In the East, people sometimes wrote proverbs on fans.
lines.en: Proverbs on fans? That's really interesting.

lines.beaver: 혹시 종교와 관련된 그림도 보신 적 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Have you ever seen paintings related to religion, too?
lines.beaver_roman: hoksi jonggyowa gwallyeondoen geurimdo bosin jeok isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네. 지난주에 성당에서 천사 그림을 봤어요.
lines.en: Sure. Last week I saw an angel painting at a cathedral.
lines.roman: ne. jinanjue seongdangeseo cheonsa geurimeul bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 서양에는 천사, 동양에는 신선 이야기가 많지요.
lines.beaver_en: The West has many angel stories, the East many immortal tales.
lines.beaver_roman: seoyangeneun cheonsa, dongyangeneun sinseon iyagiga manchiyo.
lines.en: Even with different religions, the heart of prayer is the same.

lines.beaver_en: That's right. How was your visit today?
lines.en: The cultural assets were really worth seeing. Thank you!
